assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument does not record unpaid domestic and care work for each person through specific dedicated questions (such as time spent) separately from main and secondary work. Domestic and care work is only mentioned as a reason for not attending school (P9, code 8), a reason for not working additional hours (P29a, code 1), a status category of inactivity (P36, code 4 "Ama de casa"), an occupational category (P42, code 7 "Trabajador del hogar No Remunerado"), and an activity performed while unemployed (Section 4, P2, code 4).
